follow-up time: Through pregnancy (at least until the third trimester)
outcome: Nutritional parameters (iron, vitamin B12, vitamin D, zinc)
cohort: 153 pregnant women with a history of RYGB and a singleton pregnancy of at least 24 weeks gestation
finding: A longer time interval between RYGB surgery and pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of iron deficiency anemia, but not other nutritional deficiencies, and does not appear to negatively impact pregnancy or birth outcomes.
birth_weight: Recorded, but no significant differences found between groups
